name: micro-task
description: Micro Task: a micro-task and earning platform with worker, task creator and admin roles.

scripts.setup: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c gray,blue "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
